claims.summary: Graph creation persists a design graph and may preset the DATA_FLOW menu/page.
Mapping save updates graph definition and persists the child mapping.
Mapping details are validated/processed then serialized into ruleInfo.
Mapping validation checks dependency/entities, trigger-specific settings, mapping areas and writeback.
The public mapping appservice create/update operations declare transactions.
CallDataFlow requires mapping, structure, source and output; global checks verify mapping existence.
Runtime service template accepts selected IDs, conditions, selected DTOs or event data.
Microflow calls a DataFlow runtime service and wraps its result; no direct Deduction invocation is evidenced.
Deduction graph save validates and persists a separate map object.
Deduction rule save persists rule, graph count, algorithm/details and may preset DEDUCT menu/page.
Deduction validation checks source/target hierarchy, conditions, algorithm and status/details.
Algorithm and rule details are linked and persisted as distinct child records.
Deduction code generation requires rule metadata and renders the dedicated template.
Generated deduction create listener subscribes synchronously to BeforeCreateEvent.
Create listener applies deduction and stores the mapping in source deductionInfo.
Generated update listener subscribes to BeforeUpdateEvent.
Update listener calculates old/new inputs and applies UNDO then DO when required.
Generated delete listener subscribes to BeforeDeleteEvent.
Delete listener reverses deduction with saved source/rule information.
Initialization skips FORM apps and reads versioned metadata or classpath rule/map JSON.
Entity preset default template delegates to the Excel component with explicit import/default flags.
Default template creation reuses an existing default and maps metadata/reference columns.
Template save persists signature, hierarchical column metadata and flattened Excel headers.
Excel check runs template parsing and schedules an async check; it is not a pure read.
Imported file metadata may create a template when its signature is absent.
Import returns an async redis key after publishing an event; the key is not completion.
Import event is handled asynchronously by ExcelConvertService.
Converted rows are split into create/update batches with row-level result handling.
Batch save dispatches to an entity appservice or a DAO fallback, depending on availability.
Import handler publishes completion/error-file state, sends notifications and removes temporary files.
Export starts an async event/cache operation; returning redisKey does not mean a file exists.

critical_boundaries: CALL_DATA_FLOW invokes DataFlow, not an evidenced direct Deduction call.
Deduction is generated synchronous lifecycle-listener behavior with DO/UNDO.
Excel check operations may persist foreign templates and publish async events.
A redisKey is a work handle, not import/export success.
Source version, reference jar version and deployed version remain separate.
